verification_status_at_publish.honest_summary: Extensive CDP-driven automated verification was performed this pass against the real running code (not reimplementations) — damage/HP/state/death chain, locomotion integration, a full live 100-zombie population's real AI-driven movement, several UI/interaction fixes, and a Codex regression/control-flow certification. This is NOT a real-hardware, real-human playthrough — the owner's own ten continuous minutes of real play remains the only acceptance test that matters, and several items are explicitly left open below.
what_was_proven: damage/HP/timeScale/freezeAI/pointer-lock/animation-state integrity across 90 real combat frames and 7 real hits (godmode confirmed off) — Codex-certified
full death -> results panel -> pointer-lock-release -> Again-restart flow, via real entry points and a real DOM click
raw locomotion integrator (update(dt)) is linear/stable across a 60x dt range
real AI-driven movement across the full live 100-zombie population over 40 frames produced no clean-frame teleport (one anomaly found, fully explained by that frame's own render lag)
KeyN noclip-cheat gate is fully closed to dev/cheat mode only (two separate bypasses found and fixed this pass, including one caught by an independent Codex regression review)
F3 collision-debug overlay is fully closed to dev/cheat mode only
single-target interaction halo (was: every nearby container highlighted)
Hands-off settings toggle actually controls the viewmodel (was: a completely dead stub)
grenade/molotov quick-throw (G with no prior Tab-equip) works end-to-end, including 4 session-flag cleanup gaps a Codex regression review found and this pass fixed
spatial audio: HRTF frontal-source collapse fixed (equalpower-primary), a stereo-pan sign bug fixed, per-frame listener sync added
zero_or_partial_automated_proof: the render-cost stall behind the owner's original 'freeze' report is real and reproducible, and a decisive test found it plateaus under sustained combat rather than growing unbounded (supports ordinary lazy-GPU-registration warm-up cost, not a leak) — but the stall's exact internal mechanism was not profiled further
the window-impact (breaking glass) stall (~1.26s measured once) remains completely uninvestigated beyond that one measurement

the grenade/molotov equip stall is very likely a test-harness artifact (this CDP harness's requestAnimationFrame never fires, so the game's own idle-frame warm-up system never runs) — strong converging evidence, not a fully decisive before/after comparison
audio listening quality (spatial correctness by ear, firearm punch/feel, zombie-voice variety in a real firefight) is explicitly NOT claimed — that is the owner's own judgment to make
inventory-full and wall-clipping owner reports were investigated and not reproduced on this build, but cannot be ruled out as build-age or true-ceiling/different-code-path cases
verification_status_at_publish.explicitly_not_proof: This is CDP-harness automation against a headless, software-rendered (SwiftShader) Chrome instance with an already-documented broken requestAnimationFrame limitation. Absolute timing numbers are not representative of real hardware. Real controller/mouse feel, real audio through real speakers/headphones, and sustained real play are not simulated by any of this.
